import re

# Test greedy vs non-greedy
tests = [
    # (pattern, string, description)
    (r'(.+?) *\s*world', 'hello       world', 'non-greedy with anchor'),
    (r'(.+) *\s*world', 'hello       world', 'greedy with anchor'),
    (r'\s*(.+?)\s*', ' hello ', 'center non-greedy'),
    (r'\s*(.+)\s*', ' hello ', 'center greedy'),
    (r'.+?', 'hello   world', 'standalone non-greedy'),
    (r'.+', 'hello   world', 'standalone greedy'),
]

for p, s, desc in tests:
    m = re.match(p, s) or re.search(p, s)
    if m:
        print(f"{desc}: Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: matched {m.group(1)!r}")
    else:
        print(f"{desc}: Pattern {p!r} on {s!r}: no match")
PYEOF
